scenes.headline: A dashboard for long coding tasks.
scenes.text: Running a long task in Claude Code or Codex? Meet Task Lantern.

scenes.headline: One dashboard. Across your projects.
scenes.text: One local dashboard brings your tracked threads together. Pick a thread to see the current step, progress, and blockers.

scenes.headline: Know what needs your answer.
scenes.text: Questions show what needs your answer, and what can continue while you wait. Reply in your agent chat.

scenes.headline: Details, when you need them.
scenes.text: Open the plan, files, or developer details without leaving the page.

scenes.headline: Updates come from your coding agent.
scenes.text: Your agent publishes updates as it works. No server. No extra account.

scenes.headline: Task Lantern
scenes.text: Task Lantern. Open source, for your next long task.
